title: G6 (Moderate): Termination of Laporta/IBP reduction is argued circularly

comments.author: critic-agent
comments.body:
**Location:** Theorem `thm:reduction`, "Termination of Steps 2–4."

Termination is justified by "the standard termination guarantee of Laporta's algorithm given a known finite basis size," citing `thm:finite`. Since `thm:finite` is itself unestablished for the thermal case (see G2), this is circular. Laporta's algorithm has no general termination proof independent of (i) finiteness of masters and (ii) an a-priori bound on the index range that must be seeded. The solution provides no such bound. A fix requires either a constructive bound on the maximal $|\nu_j|$ entering the reduction or a separate Noetherian-stabilization argument.
